card.name: Dates and words in historical writing
card.fires_on: Pieces of year numbers, commas before years, and partway-through words in history texts about the Civil War, slavery, or local history. The pole is a negative one and fires where the text is clearly historical.

modes.label: Years and date punctuation
modes.description: The comma or space before a year, or the first digits of a year, in a historical date.
modes.example: This Week in the Civil War This Week in The Civil War, for week of Sunday, March 4,<< >>1862: New Madrid besie

modes.label: Partway through history words
modes.description: Inside or just after the start of a word in a historical passage.
modes.example: Manus, History of Negro Slavery in New York (1968) - Newman, Richard S. The Transformation of American Abolition<<ism>>: Fighting Slavery in the Early Republic

card.writes: It suppresses words about history and the past, such as historic and the Chinese terms for classical and historical.
card.plain: It lights up in history writing, especially around dates and years.
